head: 48412522c
blockers: Hesmi skates when slowed. A 'Done when' item the implementer claims met (walk foot slide within the stride.ts bar of 10 %) does not hold in the renderer. I measured the planted foot in the real renderer while Hesmi was slowed and moving in a straight line on open RIFT ground, camera following, 60 fps. With walk weight 1 the foot slips 49-78 % of her body speed at 0.40-0.59 runRef. Her own run slips 2-11 %, and other bodies measured the same way walk at 3-9 %. In an 8-frame strip at close camera her legs barely cycle while she moves. On live, a slowed Hesmi plays the planted run at a lower timeScale and does not slide. A player who slows Hesmi sees her glide, so this is worse than live. Hesmi is one of the four walkSwitch bodies; the likely cause is her measured walkRef or walk phase rate (actors.ts walk stride / stride.ts locoCycleRate).
problems: Burdam (walkSwitch body) slowed walk slips 16-21 % of speed in the same in-renderer measurement (bar 10 %). His legs visibly cycle, so this is mild.

At the 31 m RIFT match camera, three CC kinds read from the body alone. Airborne reads clearly (lifted body, splayed limbs, shadow left on the ground). Stun reads through its stagger plus the existing star ring. Sleep is readable on open silhouettes (Odrum, Burdam slump forward) but hidden on Hesmi (backpack) and Tunlan (hat). Fear, taunt and root do not reliably read from the body at match distance. Fear seen from behind looks like a run. Taunt shows a small forward lean. Root's upper-body wrench is small next to the existing root spikes. Tunlan's hat and Hesmi's pack hide all three. The plate and VFX carry these kinds, as they do on live. Captures: 4 rotations x 8 fighters (burdam, kemdo, hesmi, lisvel, rishal, tunlan, odrum, ardit), so each kind landed on 4 different fighters. Kinds: stun, knock-up (airborne_in_place), sleep, fear, taunt, root, silence, 60 % slow. Shot at 0.15/0.35/0.6/1.0 s after the CC landed. Every actor played the intended role with its layer weight at 0.96-0.99 by 0.6 s.

Line of action, checked with my own script on live vs HEAD GLBs, frame by frame at 30 fps for all 32 re-keyed clips. Weapon-tip position at the 40 % impact frame is unchanged (0.0 cm), clip lengths are unchanged, and the impact hold is 2 frames (longer ult holds are kept). Chest yaw range before impact grows on 28 of 32 clips. It is unchanged on Dunsom ult, Odrum ult (already large) and Lisvel attack1 (a bow, as reported), and slightly lower on Ervet ult and Sukri ult. On 6 clips the fastest tip frame moved off the impact into the compressed follow-through: hesmi cast_a3 0.84->0.04, kemdo cast_a2 0.4->0.75, odrum cast_a3 0.05->0.9, burdam cast_a1 0.84->0.96, ilsheta ult 0.18->0.04, ulkro ult 0.36->0.2. A whip after contact can blur where the hit lands. This is minor.

FU-8 bars are not met on four clips (reported by the implementer, confirmed): Ervet ult and Lisvel attack1 have no counter-twist, and Ardit attack2 (0.96 m) and Rishal crit (0.76 m) have a melee strike under 1.2 m.

Not done, as the implementer says: the hasted longer stride (FU-9), FU-12 value zones, FU-13 Wick value step, units_gate and the Wick contrast gate. The 'Done when' items for units_gate and Wick contrast are not met, so the lane cannot close on these commits.

Load on the weak profile (4x CPU, perf_load practice journey, live ./deploy vs a HEAD build served the same way, back to back). Each side has one task over 250 ms between first paint and match view: live 286 ms, HEAD 282 ms. Both are the same pre-existing pointer event on Home at about 16.8 s, not from this lane. Ruling 67's bar is therefore not strictly met on either build, but there is no regression. The first minute of the match had one 115 ms frame on HEAD and none on live; I read this as noise (fps 60, min second 60). Programs 52 -> 52. Loading to HUD 3.85 -> 3.90 s.
The catalog also differs from live in Dunsom's splash (bf1847d94179 -> fbe54fa39da7). That change is not in a W3-B commit; the lead should know it rides the next catalog.

shipNotes: Do not ship d9d43302c as it stands: Hesmi glides when slowed, and the walk code would be live. Smallest fix for a round 2: leave Hesmi without a walk (walkRef undefined, so she keeps the live planted run), or fix her walk phase rate, then re-measure Hesmi and Burdam in the renderer. 35bf79c14 (the re-keys) is safe on its own as far as looks go: impact frames and clip lengths are unchanged, and no fighter's idle or run look changed. But its GLBs carry the walk clip and sit on top of d9d43302c, so it cannot ship apart from the walk GLBs. Shipping the GLBs without the stride.ts / actors.ts walk code is harmless (an unused ~7.7 KiB clip per fighter). The CC bodies in actors.ts (airborne, sleep, fear, taunt, root) and ccKindOf are safe to ship: nothing reads worse than live, airborne and sleep read better, and the sim and its hash are untouched. 48412522c is docs only.
